race.description: Phil Pottinger Memorial Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: COSTA DEL SOL (1) runs in a big field maiden without a great deal of strong exposed form. So he won't have to be great to win and has shown good things in the trials. Is from a big stable up here, an important jockey booking and the lugging bit suggests a big run on debut. MOONGLEAM (11) would be another who is bred to want a bit more ground at her first outing. It is easy to fancy these first starters in this, given some of the field. ARANDAS (15) won a trial then did a good job on debut to finish seventh at this track over 1000m. Will improve with the race experience on board. DEKKA'S LATEST (2) thereabouts during his maiden preparation but didn't threaten to win. Resuming here off a break of six-and-a-half months. Watch for any market confidence.
